== Biography ==
In 1850 seven-year-old Susanna Glassgow was recorded in Gibson County, Tennessee, in the household of James W. Glassgow, 44, born in Virginia, and Mary Glassgow, 26, born in Tennessee, with John, William, George and James. The names, age, Tennessee birthplace and later reports that Susannah's father was born in Virginia or North Carolina support this as her childhood household.<ref name="Census1850">1850 United States census, Gibson County, Tennessee, Civil District 11, p. 247b, dwelling/family 1720, lines 14–20: James W. Glassgow, 44, born Virginia; Mary, 26; John 11; William 9; Susanna 7; George 5; James 3, all children born Tennessee. NARA M432, roll 878; [https://www.us-census.org/pub/usgenweb/census/tn/gibson/1850/pg0245a.txt USGenWeb transcription], lines 29–31; accessed 26 August 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2925]] is assessed at 93% (proved). Seven-year-old Susanna is specifically transcribed in James W and Mary’s 1850 Gibson household, fitting her age and Tennessee birthplace. Her later father-birthplace reports broadly agree with James’s Virginia origin, though no held vital record calls him father.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1850 image and Susannah’s 1909 death parental fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.us-census.org/pub/usgenweb/census/tn/gibson/1850/pg0245a.txt 1850 United States census, Gibson County, Tennessee, Civil District 11, p. 247b, dwelling/family 1720, lines 14–20: James W. Glassgow, 44, born Virginia; Mary, 26; John 11; William 9; Susanna 7; George 5; James 3, all children born Tennessee. NARA M432, roll 878; USGenWeb transcription (https://www.us-census.org/pub/usgenweb/census/tn/gibson/1850/pg0245 a.txt), lines 29–31; accessed 26 August 2026.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



The 1850 household strongly supports [[Glasgow-2925|James W. Glasgow]] as Susannah's father, but no birth or vital record naming her parents has been inspected. The father relationship is therefore marked uncertain.
